models.title: Operating break-even volume in units
models.summary: The reading divides fixed costs by contribution margin per unit to obtain break-even volume.

relationship.original_equation: Break-even unit volume = fixed costs / contribution per unit
relationship.translation_notes: A unit is treated as a dimensionless count, so the contribution input is currency per one unit.

assumptions: Fixed costs are for the same activity period as the unit volume; unit contribution is positive and constant.
Sales mix, price and variable cost per unit remain constant over the relevant range.
limitations: This is a continuous accounting threshold; if units are indivisible, round up externally.
This excludes income taxes, financing costs and fixed-cost step changes.
